description: This is a unit test class 'ImmutableAclEntryTest' for testing the 'ImmutableAclEntry' class, which appears to model access control list entries with permissions and authorization subjects. The tests include immutability assertions, JSON serialization/deserialization, equality and hashcode checks, and validation of permissions logic.

classes.name: ImmutableAclEntryTest
classes.description: Unit tests for the 'ImmutableAclEntry' class, covering immutability, JSON serialization/deserialization, equality/hashCode, and permission logic tests.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Checks that ImmutableAclEntry instances are immutable and their fields are safely copied or modifiable as expected.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies that the equals and hashCode methods of ImmutableAclEntry work correctly using the EqualsVerifier library.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullAclPermission
methods.description: Ensures that creating an ImmutableAclEntry with null permissions throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullAuthorizationSubject
methods.description: Ensures that creating an ImmutableAclEntry with null authorization subject throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: entryDoesNotContainNullPermission
methods.description: Asserts that the entry does not contain null permission checks properly.

methods.name: entryDoesNotContainAllPermissionsForNull
methods.description: Checks that containsAll returns false if called with null.

methods.name: entryDoesNotContainAllPermissions
methods.description: Ensures containsAll returns false when permissions are missing.

methods.name: entryContainsAllPermissions
methods.description: Confirms that containsAll returns true when all permissions are included.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceFromNullJsonObject
methods.description: Asserts that passing null to fromJson throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceFromEmptyJsonObject
methods.description: Asserts that an empty JSON object causes fromJson to throw DittoJsonException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceFromJsonObjectContainingSchemaVersionOnly
methods.description: Checks that JSON object with only schema version throws DittoJsonException.

methods.name: createInstanceFromJsonObjectContainingMoreThanOneAclEntry
methods.description: Tests deserialization from a JSON object with multiple entries and verifies correct parsing.

methods.name: createInstanceFromJsonObjectContainingOnlyInvalidPermissions
methods.description: Checks that invalid permission JSON causes AclEntryInvalidException.

methods.name: toJsonWithSchemaVersion1ReturnsJsonObjectWithRegularFieldsOnly
methods.description: Verifies correct JSON serialization for schema version 1, ensuring only relevant fields.

methods.name: createAuthorizationSubjectContainsSlash
methods.description: Test that authorization subjects containing slashes can be created.
